name: walk
motion: walking in place at a calm pace with small natural steps, arms hanging close to the body and swinging a little, the body stays upright, no jumping, no hopping

motion_by_dir.left: walking in place with clear, alternating steps: one leg forward while the other pushes off behind, feet lifting off the ground, arms swinging opposite to the legs
motion_by_dir.right: walking in place with clear, alternating steps: one leg forward while the other pushes off behind, feet lifting off the ground, arms swinging opposite to the legs
